cards.name: Airlift
cards.text: Move any 1 pawn to any city. Get approval from that pawn's owner before moving the pawn.

cards.name: Forecast
cards.text: Draw, look at, and rearrange the top 6 cards of the Infection Deck. Put them back on top of the deck.

cards.name: Government Grant
cards.text: Add 1 research station to any city (no City card needed).

cards.name: One Quiet Night
cards.text: Skip the next Infect Cities step (do not flip over any Infection Cards).

cards.name: Resilient Population
cards.text: Remove any 1 card in the Infection Discard Pile from the game. You may play this card at any time, even during an Infect Cities or Epidemic step.

cards.name: Epidemic
cards.text:
Increase: Move the Infection Rate marker forward 1 space.
Infect: Draw the bottom card from the Infection Deck. Place 3 cubes of the appropriate color on that city.
Intensify: Take all the discarded Infection cards and shuffle them. Place them on top of the Infection Deck.

cards.name: Dispatcher
cards.text: May move any pawn, if its owner agrees, to any city containing another pawn. May move another player's pawn, with that player's approval, as if it were her own (following normal movement rules).

cards.name: Medic
cards.text: Removes all cubes of one color, not just one, when treating disease. When a disease has been cured, cubes of that color are automatically removed from any city she is in or moves to, without using an action.

cards.name: Scientist
cards.text: Needs only 4 cards of the same disease color, instead of 5, to discover a cure.

cards.name: Researcher
cards.text: May give any City card from her hand to another player, as long as both players' pawns are in the same city. The card does not have to match the city it is given in.

cards.name: Operations Expert
cards.text: May build a research station in her current city without discarding a City card. Once per turn, may move from a research station to any city by discarding any City card.

cards.name: Contingency Planner
cards.text: May take any Event card from the discard pile and store it on her role card (not in her hand). Once that Event card is played, it is removed from the game. She may only store one Event card at a time.

cards.name: Quarantine Specialist
cards.text: Prevents outbreaks and the placement of disease cubes in the city she is in and all cities connected to it.

cards.name: New Assignment
cards.text: Play at the start of your turn, before drawing cards. Discard your role card and take on a new, randomly drawn role for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Mobile Hospital
cards.text: For the rest of the game, whenever any player treats a disease in a city, also remove 1 cube (of any color present) from each city adjacent to it.

cards.name: Remote Treatment
cards.text: Remove up to 2 cubes of the same color from the same city, or 1 cube each from 2 different cities.

cards.name: Special Orders
cards.text: Play at any time. For the rest of this turn, you may move any other pawn, if its owner agrees, as if it were your own.

cards.name: Borrowed Time
cards.text: Play during your action phase. Take 2 extra actions immediately; they must be used this turn.

cards.name: Mutation
cards.text: Resolved like a standard Epidemic card, but used only in the Mutation Challenge: after Infect and Intensify, place a Mutation disease cube on the city drawn instead of a standard cube.

cards.name: Containment Specialist
cards.text: Prevents outbreaks in the city she is in and all cities connected to it, and automatically removes 1 cube from a city with 2 or more cubes of the same color whenever she enters it.

cards.name: Epidemiologist
cards.text: May take a card from another player's hand, or give a card to another player, as long as her pawn is in the same city as that player's pawn OR a city connected to it (does not need to share the city).

cards.name: Field Operative
cards.text: May take a 'sample' (place a sample cube from supply onto her role card) when treating a disease, instead of removing a cube. May discover a cure using 3 City cards of one color plus 3 matching sample cubes, at any city (no research station required).

cards.name: Generalist
cards.text: Takes 5 actions on her turn instead of 4.

cards.name: Troubleshooter
cards.text: May look at the top card of the Infection Deck at any time. When she has no cards in hand, she may also look at the top card of the Player Deck.

cards.name: The Bio-Terrorist
cards.text: A hidden fifth role used only in the Bio-Terrorist Challenge. Secretly works against the other players to spread the Mutation disease across the board, and wins if the Mutation disease outbreaks a set number of times before the team cures all four standard diseases.

cards.name: Re-Examined Research
cards.text: Play at any time. Take any 1 Event card from the discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Improved Sanitation
cards.text: For the rest of the game, decrease the Infection Rate by 1 step (minimum of the lowest marked value).

cards.name: Infection Zone Ban
cards.text: Choose a city. For the rest of the game, that city cannot receive disease cubes from Infect or Epidemic steps.

cards.name: Field Director
cards.text: May move any other pawn, with its owner's approval, from her city or an adjacent city to any city connected to its current location, as one action. May also treat disease in an adjacent city as an action.

cards.name: Local Liaison
cards.text: May give any player a City card matching the city both pawns are currently in, regardless of whose card it is. May also share cards as the Researcher does within the same color region.

cards.name: Pilot
cards.text: Once per turn, may fly directly to any city within 3 connections of her current city, and may carry one other pawn in her city along with her.

cards.name: Virologist
cards.text: May discard a City card matching a disease color to remove 1 cube of that color from any city on the board, regardless of her own location. May use 2 City cards of one color as if they were 1 card of the cure color when discovering a cure.

cards.name: Emergency Conference
cards.text: Play at any time. Gather all players' pawns together in any one city of your choice.

cards.name: Emergency Response
cards.text: Play at any time. Immediately remove 1 cube of any color from any city.

cards.name: Emergency Event
cards.text: Represents the Emergency Event deck used in the Emergency Events Challenge: when drawn, read it aloud and resolve its effect immediately; some Emergency Events have continuous effects that last until another Emergency Event is drawn.

cards.name: First Responder
cards.text: May move to any city with a research station as an action. Before the first Infect Cities step of the game, may remove 1 cube from a city about to be seeded.

cards.name: Pharmacist
cards.text: May treat a disease in any city by discarding a matching City card, as an action, without needing to be in that city.

cards.name: Veterinarian
cards.text: Has special interactions with the animal-to-human infection chain used in the Hinterlands Challenge, including removing animal disease cubes.

cards.name: Gene Splicer
cards.text: May discover a cure at a research station in a city of the color being cured by turning in 2 City cards of that color plus 1 City card of each of the other three disease colors.

cards.name: Colonel
cards.text: Used with the Quarantine module; when the Colonel is in play, all 6 Quarantine markers are used instead of the normal number, and he has special authority over placing them.
